headline: Sensex and Nifty crash over 1,000 points as FII selling and high bond yields trigger massive wealth erosion

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy selling pressure from Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) selling Indian stocks en-masse
US Treasury yields scaling their highest levels since 2002, dampening global investor sentiment
UK 30-year gilt yields topping 6% for the first time since 1998, causing global market jitters
Concerns over rising crude oil prices and the impact of sustained global interest rate hikes
whatHappening: The Sensex plummeted over 1,200 points intraday, reaching its lowest level of 2026
Investor wealth worth approximately Rs 9 lakh crore was eroded in a single trading session
Indian benchmark indices recorded their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years
Adani Group highlighted the completion or execution of projects worth Rs 2.6 lakh crore in Maharashtra
summary: Indian benchmark indices crashed as the Sensex plummeted over 1,200 points, wiping out Rs 9 lakh crore in investor wealth. The slump was driven by heavy FII selling and surging global bond yields, marking the market's longest weekly losing streak in 25 years. Amid the decline, Adani Group announced significant project milestones in Maharashtra while SEBI updated its document verification system.
